scope: Blind source-backed scoring of visualization and instructions reports only.
interpretation_notes: Scores apply the frozen finite causal items, not report length or additional filenames. Whole-report connected evidence counts.
No production files, candidate method materials, mappings, metrics or other trial outcomes were used. Only the rubric, anonymous reports and this run's snapshot informed grading.
Incidental detail is not mandatory where the causal relationship is complete; omissions are not automatically major false claims.
source_verification: Read snapshot graph host lifecycle, group replacement, settings acknowledgement, geometry/cache/static-layout/drag source and the three required test families.
Read snapshot UI graph precollection, Copilot/Cursor/bulk writers, active compact content builder, filesystem/UI catches and compact service tests.
Independently checked Cursor's getLocale consumer against the snapshot i18n provider.

rubric_flaws.description: The frozen rubric's parenthetical 'locale-aware there' overstates the effective Cursor behavior. The Cursor wrapper compares getLocale() with 'zh', but getLocale returns zh-CN/en-US; the current caller therefore selects English. The scored shared-builder dependency and sequential partial-failure relationship are unaffected.
rubric_flaws.scoring_effect: No retroactive change to the frozen item. Correctly noticing this extra bug earns no extra point; incidental locale shorthand is not treated as a major error about the requested Copilot or shared/batch path.

audit_notes.quote: calls the same router with a locale-dependent title/language
audit_notes.judgment: This describes the apparent wrapper branch but is not effective locale behavior because the provider returns region-tagged codes. Recorded as non-major imprecision tied to the rubric flaw, not a false Copilot-language claim or shared routing/sequencing mistake.
Correctly identifies the zh versus zh-CN mismatch; not an extra scored requirement.

Full causal lifecycle coverage through replace/hide/conditional resume/disposal and stale-callback consequences. Does not separately name beforeunload; treated as incidental event detail under the frozen instruction not to require every listed implementation detail.
